'''Sun'il Ei'de''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] musician and professional [[Drum/Legends|drum]] player for the popular [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]] band known as [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]].<ref name="SWCE" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Sun'il was on stage in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] during the Modal Nodes' performance of "[[Mad About Me/Legends|Mad About Me]]."<ref name="ANH" /> Sun'il was also one of the five Modal Nodes that played in the cantina during the Imperial curfew of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="Star Wars Blog">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-holiday-special-cantina-we-may-not-thrive-friend-but-we-survive-friend|text=''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who|int=The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sun'il Ei'de is the seventh Bith musician visible on stage in the Mos Eisley cantina sequence during [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Barely visible, the seventh Modal Node was the subject of speculation for decades until a picture from the film on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] clearly showed all seven Modal Nodes on stage.<ref name="SW_comEncyc">{{SWE|locations|cantina|Mos Eisley Cantina}} {{Po}}</ref> The [[Star Wars Blog]] article ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who]]'' also identified Sun'il Ei'de as one of the five Modal Nodes who accompany the bartender [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]] in her rendition of "[[Goodnight, But Not Goodbye/Legends|Goodnight, But Not Goodbye]]."
